_comment: What Rust and TypeScript must agree on about a click's naming (docs/spec/02-capture.md#click-naming). elementKinds and namingSources are the values a stored naming may hold (packages/core/src/step-text, crates/library/src/schema.rs). frameworkNames are a UI framework's own names for its hosts, compared without anything but letters, digits and underscores and without case; lightDismissAutomationIds mark the invisible layer a XAML menu lays over its window. The TypeScript naming takes both off an element's facts (uia-adapter.ts readableFacts); the Windows recorder uses them to decide when to walk down to the element under the click (crates/capture/src/uia.rs). frameworkNameCases are names with the class name beside them, and whether they are a framework's.
